name: ORGAN TRIO
author: ashtonwallen (built on AMB-1 by Charles Vestal)
tagline: Endless soul-jazz organ trio. Drawbars, rotating speaker, guitar, drums.
description: ORGAN TRIO turns the M-VAVE FM-1 into a soul-jazz organ trio playing an endless set: tonewheel organ with drawbars, percussion and a rotating speaker, jazz guitar, drums, the organist's left hand on bass. Every tune is new: greasy medium blues, slow minor blues in 12/8, soul-jazz grooves, gospel ballads with swells, shuffles and swing. Organ and guitar solo and trade fours; the organ builds to a climax with the speaker on fast and the drawbars pulled out. On screen, the drawbars moving and the speaker's horn and drum turning. Thirteen bands.
credits: Built on AMB-1 by Charles Vestal, on fm1-base and felucca-bsp, from Felucca by Leo Kuroshita (Hügelton Instruments).
